acceptance_criteria.condition: Level 1 and Level 2 repairs require observation, invariant separation, full-path mapping, hypothesis discrimination, earliest-owner intervention, regression, runtime verification, and residual-risk recording before completion.
The forward scorer accepts a complete prose repair record and rejects missing invariant, observability, alternative, ledger, counterfactual, or runtime evidence.
Existing Skill behavior and metadata contract remain intact while the evidence-first gate is added.
The Skill package remains valid and the changed Python sources are syntactically valid with no patch whitespace errors.

invariants: SKILL.md remains the single normative policy source for the new repair gate.
Level 0 documentation work remains outside the mandatory behavioral repair gate.
Unknown, unrun, read-only, and in-memory evidence cannot be promoted to a root-cause completion claim.
The scorer accepts the prose format allowed by the Skill without weakening required ledger fields.

safeguards.name: owner-first causal repair gate
safeguards.rationale: The normative sequence requires a discriminating probe and earliest responsible owner before intervention, preventing repeated symptom patches.

safeguards.name: unknown and authority calibration
safeguards.rationale: The policy distinguishes executed, verified, unrun, read-only, and unavailable evidence and forbids production action authorization by the gate.

safeguards.name: redacted bounded observability
safeguards.rationale: Blind nodes require the smallest redacted low-cardinality probe or an explicit unknown conclusion.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md owns the normative workflow, README and UI metadata summarize it, and the scorer owns only deterministic forward-test checks.

dependency_audit.rationale: No package, runtime, external service, or tool dependency was added.

extension_decision.rationale: The evidence-first gate extends the existing causal and evidence disciplines without replacing them.

data_ownership.rationale: This Skill-package change creates no business-data or runtime persistence path.

error_model.rationale: Failed checks and unresolved causal ownership remain explicit failures or unknowns rather than silent completion.

contract_evolution.rationale: Normative instructions, README summary, UI prompt, contract tests, and forward tests were updated together.

operational_budget.rationale: The change adds no runtime algorithm, service call, or resource-sensitive production path.

threat_boundary.rationale: The gate retains the existing secure-code-path rules and explicitly prevents unauthorized production actions.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: Focused checks, full regression, package validation, compilation, and diff checks were executed before completion.

release_recovery.rationale: The package change has no independent production rollout; reverting the scoped files removes the policy extension.

data_migration.rationale: No persisted schema or stored data changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No credentials, environment configuration, or secret-handling code changed.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency, lockfile, CI action, or downloaded tool changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The gate documents the evidence record, failed-attempt ledger, observability boundary, counterfactual status, and stopping conditions for future repairs.

reproducibility.rationale: The scorer and forward tests are standard-library based, and all verification artifacts bind commands, timestamps, revision, and hashes.

remaining_risks: The forward test validates the gate scorer and representative response behavior; it does not prove a general improvement in model repair success.
No preregistered no_skill/old_skill/new_skill statistical experiment was run in this turn, so no model-wide effectiveness claim is made.
The runtime impact depends on future agents actually reading and following the Skill; the package cannot enforce behavior in an unrelated repository by itself.
